svg.title: Northwest Community College - historical white logo
svg.desc: Original vector artwork extracted from 2015 Smithers Golf Tournament and Student Bursary Fundraiser sponsor sheet, page 1. Source: https://www.coastmountaincollege.ca/docs/default-source/about/cmtn-foundation/2015_ty_golf_smithers.pdf.
